# Site guide — maintain the EkGuru portal safely

## Source of truth, routes and generated files

- `Computer Network/data/cn_questions.json` is the canonical CN bank (schema v2). Review source content and evidence before promoting a record.
- `index.html`, `subjects/`, `maps/`, `practice/`, `study-material/`, and `sources/` are the GitHub Pages portal routes. The root catalogue uses `assets/css/site.css` and `assets/js/app.js`; the shared practice application remains at `practice/index.html` and uses `assets/css/portal.css`, `assets/js/app.mjs`, and the pure `assets/js/engine.mjs` module.
- `assets/catalog/{subjects,resources,maps}.json`, `data/reports/portal_repository_inventory.csv`, and `Rajasthan Geography Maps/STRUCTURE_AND_ASSET_INVENTORY.md` are generated by `tools/build_catalog.py`. Do not hand-edit generated catalogue outputs.
- `assets/catalog.min.json`, `assets/banks/cn/manifest.json`, `assets/banks/cn/Tnn.<hash>.min.json`, `assets/source-register.min.json`, `assets/cn-questions.min.json`, and `data/reports/build_manifest.json` belong to the existing CN data pipeline and are generated. Do not hand-edit them.
- All browser-facing internal links must work under the GitHub Pages project path `/Questions-/`. Use project-relative URLs; do not assume the site is hosted at the domain root.
- The portal is static and dependency-free at runtime. No server-side service, sign-in, analytics, ad network, cloud storage or third-party JavaScript is required.

## Contributor file placement and website read paths

The public route tree is separate from original source material. Do not move legacy files to make the repository look uniform; follow the topic guide for new additions and register every file that should be shown to students.

| File purpose | Keep/add files here | Website/builder behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Public routes | `index.html`, `subjects/<slug>/index.html`, `maps/`, `practice/`, `study-material/`, `sources/`, `guides/` | GitHub Pages serves these route files directly under `/Questions-/`. |
| Shared catalogue UI | `assets/css/site.css`, `assets/js/app.js` | Shared styles and data-driven catalogue page renderer. |
| Practice player | `practice/index.html`, `assets/css/portal.css`, `assets/js/app.mjs`, `assets/js/engine.mjs` | Existing CN player; it loads generated manifests/chunks, not arbitrary question files. |
| Editable site catalogues | `data/catalog/subjects.json`, `books.json`, `portal_resources.json`, plus exam/mapping source JSON | Inputs to the catalogue/data builders; edit source records, then rebuild. |
| Generated browser catalogues | `assets/catalog/*.json`, `assets/catalog.min.json`, `assets/banks/cn/*` | Website-readable outputs. Do not hand-edit; regenerate and validate. |
| New CN topic study files | `Computer Network/Topics/T01/` through `T07/` | Register PDFs in `data/catalog/books.json` and the CN `book_ids` list in `data/catalog/subjects.json`; rebuild both catalogues. Existing files stay in their current paths. |
| New CN question-source PDFs | `Computer Network/Incoming/` | Staging for ingestion and human review; not published as approved questions on file-copy alone. |
| Curated CN question data | `tools/data/topicN_data.py` and associated pending/review modules | CN exporter/build pipeline produces canonical records and practice chunks. Preserve evidence/status distinctions. |
| Geography source files | Keep the two existing roots separate: `Rajasthan Geography Maps/` and `Geography/Map/Rajasthan/` | Register a new CSV/document in `data/catalog/portal_resources.json`; new gallery images also need a map-builder entry, alt text and source/QA review. |
| Tests/builders/reports | `tests/`, `tools/`, `data/reports/`, `archive/` | Maintainer, QA or preserved-history areas; not automatic student-facing content. |

Website catalogues do **not** crawl every folder. A file appears only when a route or the correct catalogue/builder exposes it. Check paths exactly as written; GitHub Pages is case-sensitive. The bilingual, browser-readable version is at [`guides/repository-structure/index.html`](guides/repository-structure/index.html), and editable catalogue examples are in [`data/catalog/README.md`](data/catalog/README.md).

From the repository root, `python3 tools/read_structure.py` prints the map. After preparing a merge or changing paths, run `python3 tools/read_structure.py --check`; it detects unresolved Git merge entries and verifies generated manifests, links, assets, subject gates and whitespace. It does not replace the full release/browser/PDF suite.

### New-repository merge sequence

1. Fetch and inspect the incoming tree and overlapping paths before merging; do not overlay a nested repository root or blindly copy generated catalogues.
2. Start the merge on the intended feature branch with `git merge --no-commit --no-ff FETCH_HEAD` so conflicts can be reviewed before completing it.
3. Keep original material in the documented subject/source folders, update catalogue inputs and rebuild generated files.
4. Run `python3 tools/read_structure.py --check`, then `python3 tools/run_release_checks.py`; inspect `git status` and the complete diff. If the merge is unsafe before it is completed, use `git merge --abort`.
5. Do not merge to `main` before review and verification. This preflight does not test a live deployment.

## Subject publication and geography safeguards

- Computer Network is the live question bank. Counts are derived from canonical/build manifests; official paper + final-key verification is separate from answer checking and unverified PYQ claims.
- Rajasthan Geography is a live resource library only. It has no question-bank count or practice test.
- Keep `Rajasthan Geography Maps/` and `Geography/Map/Rajasthan/` distinct. Read their own READMEs, source audits, QA reports and discrepancy/input audits before changing the catalogue. The portal's map and boundary status remains **Needs verification** until the recorded conflicts are independently resolved.
- Do not infer geographic boundary facts from a map preview, CSV row count or an older audit. Render existing CSV values as recorded and link the relevant audit; do not silently reconcile or guess.
- Preserve original maps, CSVs, PDFs, source registers and CBT files in place. The catalogue builder is read-only with respect to source assets. The optimized WebP atlas preview is a derivative; it does not replace the original PNG.
- PDF and external official-source anchors that open a new tab must visibly say so and include `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Internal links remain same-tab. Full-size map PNG actions currently stay in the same tab so Back works as expected.

## Rebuild after question-source changes

1. Update the source data in the existing question modules; preserve original PDFs, HTML, source files and audit material.
2. Run the exporter; it writes the canonical bank and regenerates downstream CN site data/reports:

   ```bash
   python3 tools/cn_export_json.py
   ```

3. Run CN validation and the repository release checks as appropriate:

   ```bash
   python3 tools/validate_question_bank.py
   python3 tools/audit_blueprints.py
   python3 tools/audit_links.py --strict
   python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/data -p 'test_*.py' -v
   python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/navigation -p 'test_*.py' -v
   python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/responsive -p 'test_*.py' -v
   node --test tests/engine/engine.test.mjs
   ```

4. For portal catalogue/source changes, rebuild and validate the repository-derived manifests:

   ```bash
   python3 tools/build_catalog.py
   python3 tools/build_catalog.py --check
   python3 tools/validate_links.py
   python3 tools/validate_assets.py
   python3 tools/validate_subjects.py
   ```

5. Confirm generated build IDs and SHA-256 values agree. Exact duplicates and near-duplicate candidates are reports, not automatic deletion decisions.
6. Before release, run rendered browser tests at phone, tablet, laptop and desktop widths, keyboard/accessibility checks, and a post-deployment smoke test. A passing structural CSS test is not a visual-browser pass. Record browser emulation separately from physical-device QA.

## Evidence and status rules

- Only stable question IDs mapped to an official exam paper **and** final/corrected official key in `data/sources/official_paper_key_evidence.json` can be `paper_and_key_checked` / `verified_official_pyq`.
- `answer_checked` means answer-level curation only. It does not imply an official appearance or answer-key match.
- `claimed_pyq_unverified`, `claimed_answer_unverified`, `disputed`, and `pending_review` remain distinct. Disputed/pending records are excluded from test chunks; incomplete source wording is retained in canonical data, not repaired by guessing.
- Exam tags and difficulty are practice filters. They do not prove a past appearance or an official exam blueprint.
- Planned subjects stay unavailable until a reviewed bank, data builder, validation tests, source report and release checks exist. Do not change `status` to `live` as a display-only edit.
- “Save for later” is a browser-local bookmark. Do not call it a push/email notification.

## Catalog changes

Edit source drafts under `data/catalog/`:

- `subjects.json`: subject publication status, descriptions and syllabus topics.
- `exams.json`: practice profiles, references, and explicit pattern/simulation confidence.
- `syllabus_mappings.json`: topic mappings and their evidence status.
- `books.json`: existing/new CN topic PDF paths and generated launcher paths.
- `portal_resources.json`: curated non-book resources, currently constrained to supported live subject/source roots.

For a new CN topic study PDF, use `Computer Network/Topics/TNN/`, add a unique `books.json` record with the matching `topic_id`, and add its ID to the CN `book_ids` array in `subjects.json`. For a new geography report/CSV, keep it under one of the two audited source trees and register it in `portal_resources.json`; adding a gallery image also requires map-builder metadata and image/accessibility review. Do not put geography maps in the CN topic directories.

For every new catalogue resource, confirm its exact tracked path and source/status before adding it. The builder rejects missing files, mismatched topic folders and paths escaping the repository, emits file sizes and SHA-256, and marks unresolved source information. Run `python3 tools/build_site_data.py` when CN source/catalogue inputs change, then `python3 tools/build_catalog.py` and `python3 tools/read_structure.py --check`.

`Computer Network/Online Quiz/v6/` launchers are generated by `tools/build_v6_launchers.py`; original legacy quiz bytes are preserved as snapshots and their former public paths redirect to the shared practice app. Do not reactivate a stale standalone quiz without addressing its embedded verification labels.

## Data and rollback

Before changing a published file, preserve prior sources/release artifacts. The pre-audit root page, compatibility asset, reports and all seven original quiz HTML snapshots are kept under `archive/pre-audit-2026-10-14/`; archived HTML files use a non-runnable `.snapshot` suffix but retain their original bytes. Original PDFs remain in place. A byte-for-byte copy of the immediately prior canonical bank (SHA-256 `5d431ff72300cd55867d322c99223cb5c835926b63e2854e510b8199d67ba6fa`) is at `archive/pre-audit-2026-10-14/Computer Network/data/cn_questions.pre-refresh.json`; `cn_questions.v1.original.json` is an older snapshot. To roll back the portal implementation, restore the pre-audit root page and compatibility asset from `archive/pre-audit-2026-10-14/`; this does not automatically remove the new route directories. Restore archived reports or older question data only if intentionally rolling back those separate migrations. The seven old public HTML paths are redirect wrappers; to intentionally reactivate one old snapshot, copy its matching `.html.snapshot` back to the original `.html` path only after addressing stale `verified_official_pyq` labels. For a full branch rollback after commit, use `git revert <feature-commit>` on this branch. Do not delete versioned chunks/catalog files without checking what the current page references.
